verdict.rationale: The evidence shows v0 generating code, connecting apps to databases, and diagnosing build logs to apply fixes. None of it documents v0 analyzing a user's own data to surface AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. Database integrations and log-based build fixes are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
